## Tyrant Centipede (CR 23)

**XP** 819,200  
N Colossal magical beast  
**Init** +8; **Senses** blindsight 60 ft., low-light vision, see in darkness, tremorsense 300 ft.; Perception +36; Aura antimagic field (30 ft.)  


**Defense**


**AC** 37, touch 7, flat-footed 32 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +30 natural, -8 size)  
**hp** 690 (30d10+390)  
**Fort** +29, **Ref** +21, **Will** +16  
**DR** 10/epic; **Immune** acid, mind-affecting, poison; **Resist** fire 30, electricity 20, sonic 20; **SR** 34  


**Offense**


**Speed** 60 ft., burrow 30 ft., climb 60 ft.  
**Melee** bite +41 (8d10+36/19-20/x4 plus grab and poison)  
**Space** 30 ft.; **Reach** 30 ft.  
**Special Attacks** constrict (8d10+36), rend armor  


**Statistics**


**Str** 46, **Dex** 19, **Con** 34, **Int** 5, **Wis** 19, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +30; **CMB** +56 (+60 grapple and sunder); **CMD** 73 (can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** Cornugon Smash, Critical Focus, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Greater Sunder, Greater Vital Strike, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Sunder, Improved Vital Strike, Iron Will, Staggering Critical, Stunning Critical, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (bite), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
**Skills** Climb +30, Perception +36  
**Languages** Aklo (can’t speak)  


**Special Abilities**


**Poison (Ex)** Bite–injury; *save* Fortitude DC 37; *frequency* 1/round for 10 rounds; *effect* 1d6 Dex drain; *cure* 2 consecutive saves.  

**Ruinous Mandibles (Ex)** The bite attack of the tyrant centipede adds double its Strength bonus to damage, ignores damage reduction and deals quadruple damage on a critical hit.  

**Rend Armor (Ex)** If a tyrant centipede grapples an opponent wearing armor, it chews away the armor with its powerful mandibles. With a successful grapple check it gets a free sunder attempt targeting the opponent’s armor and ignoring its hardness.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** underground  
**Organization** solitary Treasure incidental
